svg.title: How one track blends into the next
svg.desc: Line chart of level against the bars of a 32 bar blend. The incoming track rises from silence to full level over the first 16 bars while the outgoing one stays full, then the outgoing one falls to silence over the last 16. Their bass lines, dashed, cross at bar 9: the incoming bass comes in and the outgoing bass goes out within one beat, so the two basslines never play together.
svg.text: How one track blends into the next
A blend of 32 bars with the bass swap at bar 9.
